outcome.description: Observed resolution result; only the Skill machine maps it to a terminal.

headRef.description: Current durable head reference when exactly one authorized current match was found; otherwise null.

headSha256.description: Current durable head hash when found; otherwise null.

snapshotSha256.description: Redacted snapshot hash when found; never a transcript body.

artifactRefs.description: Authorized artifact references from the current head; empty unless found.

reason.description: Single evidence-backed reason for the outcome.

evidenceRefs.description: Policy, scope, index, and head evidence used for this resolution.
